info.title: Neosian storage HTTP contract
info.description: Storage wire 6, independent of package version. Bodies are JSON objects regardless of Content-Type; unknown request keys are ignored and optional null equals absence. JSON Schema describes supported typed input, not legacy coercions. Scope/conversation allowances are literal prefixes; constrained tokens cannot call store/* or /mcp and must explicitly bound conversation searches/trail reads. MCP at /mcp is a separate negotiated protocol, not described by this document.
